title: Yakuza 5 - Wasteful Emotions ~ Baka Mitai [Sky Finance Edition] (Remix)
description:
𝐼'𝓂 𝓈𝓊𝒸𝒽 𝒶 𝓂𝑒𝓈𝓈, 𝐼'𝓂 𝓁𝑜𝓈𝓉, 𝐼'𝓂 𝓃𝑜 𝑔𝑜𝑜𝒹 𝒶𝓉 𝓉𝒽𝒾𝓈
𝐼'𝓂 𝒾𝓃 𝓁𝑜𝓋𝑒, 𝓈𝓉𝒾𝓁𝓁 𝒾𝓃 𝓁𝑜𝓋𝑒, 𝓈𝓉𝒾𝓁𝓁 𝒾𝓃 𝓁𝑜𝓋𝑒 𝓌𝒾𝓉𝒽 𝓎𝑜𝓊
𝐻𝒶𝓇𝒹 𝒶𝓈 𝐼 𝓉𝓇𝓎, 𝐼 𝒸𝒶𝓃'𝓉 𝑒𝓋𝑒𝓃 𝒹𝓇𝒾𝓃𝓀 𝓉𝒽𝒾𝓈 𝓅𝒶𝒾𝓃 𝒶𝓌𝒶𝓎
𝑀𝑒𝓂𝑜𝓇𝒾𝑒𝓈 𝑜𝒻 𝓎𝑜𝓊, 𝓉𝓌𝒾𝓈𝓉𝒾𝓃𝑔 𝓂𝓎 𝓋𝒾𝑒𝓌, 𝐼'𝓋𝑒 𝒷𝑒𝑒𝓃 𝒶 𝒻𝑜𝑜𝓁

Did an arrangement of Baka Mitai [Sky Finance Edition] from Yakuza 5 for Summer C3 2022. It's THE SONG. The unofficial Yakuza / Ryu ga Gotoku national anthem. This was originally gonna be in the Winter C3 2022 thread but because I was unsatisfied with it back then, I had to scrap it. I ended up redoing it completely for this C3 given I wanted to do it justice, especially as a Yakuza fan. Kinda like some other songs I've done, I wanted to do a more fast-pace, upbeat version of this song.

Important:
♠ "Bonus End," Yoshi, P-Switch, & Thunder SFX are disabled.

There are also customizable pitches for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
1. A# Minor (Original Pitch, turned on default)
2. G Minor (Kazuma Pitch)
3. A Minor (Custom Pitch)

There are also customizable versions for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
1. Enables Voice Clip, but disables SMW-Compatibility Completely
2. Disables Voice Clip (turned on default)
